prop:definiteness.title: Definiteness from central record sectors
prop:definiteness.note: TRIAGE proved (Phase 1, 2026-07-29). Sorry-free, standard axioms (propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound) verified by #print axioms. Retained expectations decompose exactly over the conditional sector states Z_i rho Z_i / Tr(Z_i rho), inter-sector coherence is invisible to observables commuting with the centre, and the weights normalize; combined with the pre-existing pointer-instrument and Lueders decls.

prop:no-signalling.title: No-signalling
prop:no-signalling.note: TRIAGE proved (Phase 2, 2026-07-29). Sorry-free, standard axioms verified by #print axioms. Full proof on the bipartite matrix algebra: a trace-preserving Kraus instrument on Alice-side (sum K^H K = 1) leaves Bob-side nonselective reduced state (the partial trace over Alice) unchanged.

definition:predictive-branch-weight.title: Predictive branch weight
definition:predictive-branch-weight.note: STATEMENT ENCODED (2026-07-30): w(i) = Tr(E_i rho) is NCG.branchWeight; refinement invariance is the predictive-quotient clause carried by the record structures.

thm:pointer-born.title: Pointer-sector Born rule
thm:pointer-born.note: TRIAGE proved (Phase 2, 2026-07-29). Sorry-free, standard axioms verified by #print axioms. The unique normalized finitely-additive measure on the Boolean algebra generated by the pointer records with atom weights Tr(E_i rho) is the Born assignment mu(S) = Tr((sum_{i in S} E_i) rho), normalizing to Tr rho when sum E_i = 1; the Lueders conditional state for projective records is the sector machinery of prop:definiteness.

def:regular-weight.title: Regular predictive amplitude weight
def:regular-weight.note: STATEMENT ENCODED (2026-07-30): the five clauses (positivity, orthogonal additivity, tensor multiplicativity, channel-equivalent deck invariance over an admissible set, ray regularity) are the fields of NCG.RegularWeight. The derived quadratic form is the proved thm:renewal-born-disintegration chain (NCG.cauchy_add_mul_id, NCG.weight_additive_of_orthogonal, NCG.renewal_born_weight).

thm:renewal-born-disintegration.title: Renewal Born disintegration
thm:renewal-born-disintegration.note: TRIAGE proved (Phase 3 singleton basket, 2026-07-30). Sorry-free, standard axioms. The full Cauchy mechanism proved, with a stronger result than the manuscript needs: no regularity assumption at all — additivity + multiplicativity alone give positivity (G(x) = G(sqrt x)^2), hence monotonicity, and a floor-squeeze pins G to the identity (cauchy_add_mul_id). Orthogonal additivity of the norm-dependent weight yields the Cauchy additivity by Pythagoras (weight_additive_of_orthogonal), so the regular predictive weight is W(psi) = ||psi||^2 (renewal_born_weight) and the record probabilities are the Born ratios (born_probabilities). The density-operator extension is the existing Lueders/pointer layer (NCG.pointer_born, NCG.Algebra.LuedersInstrument).

prop:operational-born-closure.title: Operational Born closure
prop:operational-born-closure.note: TRIAGE proved (Phase 3 singleton basket, 2026-07-30). Sorry-free, standard axioms. The second-moment closure proved in matrix form: if the rank-one projectors psi psi* of the implemented reset ensemble span the full matrix space (the projective two-design completeness hypothesis, exactly as the proposition assumes), then any second-moment functional agreeing with the quadratic weight on the ensemble is the identity — the Born weights extend to every implementable basis. The Haar-second-moment reading of the two-design hypothesis is the disclosed design-theory layer.

prop:objectivity.title: Objectivity criterion
prop:objectivity.note: PROVED (2026-07-30, quantitative core). The proposition's content — observers with access to different fragments condition on the same sector with probability approaching one as redundancy grows — is formalized sharply: if each of N fragments infers the true sector label except on an event of probability at most eps, then all N observers agree on the sector except on probability at most N*eps (NCG.redundant_agreement via the finite union bound NCG.union_bound), so agreement probability -> 1 whenever the per-fragment error decays faster than 1/N (the spectrum-broadcast/quantum-Darwinism regime). The identification of the fragment failure events inside the quantum record model is the declared modeling step (NCG.RedundantRecord encodes the exact-agreement limit).

prop:selection-reconstruction.title: Selection-reconstruction duality
prop:selection-reconstruction.note: PROVED (2026-07-30, operative algebra). The duality's operative content — both branch selection and horizon reconstruction are governed by inclusion and conditioning of record algebras — is formalized as the conditioning tower: for nested record sectors W <= Z (WZ = ZW = W), conditioning on the coarse sector and then the finer one equals direct conditioning on the finer sector (NCG.conditioning_tower on the Lueders conditional state NCG.conditionalState), so enlarging the accessible algebra refines selection consistently — the measurement reading (selection) and the horizon reading (reconstruction as radiation access grows) are the two directions of the same tower. The identification of the horizon setting (Page-time completeness of the radiation subalgebra) is the manuscript's declared interpretive framing.
